name: 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (3D CNNs)
definition: 3D convolutions extend the 2D sliding window operation to volumetric grids, with encoder-decoder architectures stacking downsampling and upsampling stages to extract and reconstruct spatial features.
summary: 3D CNNs are neural networks that extend 2D sliding windows to volumetric grids for extracting spatial features, distinguished by their reliance on standard convolutional stacks rather than specialized implicit representations.
